name: donkey-cut
description: Create and edit videos in Donkey Cut from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Donkey Cut is an open-source video editor.

Import footage, trim and arrange clips, add captions and titles, and preview your edits.

Open existing projects or start a new video, undo changes as you work, and export the finished result when you're ready.

Open Donkey Cut from the sidebar or beside a conversation to pick a project, or @-mention a project in the composer to work on it.
defaultPrompt: Open my latest Donkey Cut project
Start a vertical video for TikTok in Donkey Cut
Add captions to my Donkey Cut project

positive.description: Lists the account's cloud projects and opens the projects home.
positive.prompt: Show me my Donkey Cut projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected account's cloud projects with their names, most recent first.

positive.description: Creates a vertical project and opens it in the editor card.
positive.prompt: Start a new vertical Donkey Cut video called Weekend recap.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 9:16 project named Weekend recap and shows the Donkey Cut editor in the card.

positive.description: Edits the open project with individual editing tools.
positive.prompt: In Donkey Cut, make my newest project square and add a title that says HELLO.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the project, sets the aspect to 1:1 and adds a HELLO title; the card shows both changes.

positive.prompt: Undo that last Donkey Cut edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Reverts the most recent edit in the open project and says what changed.

positive.description: Exports the finished video for download.
positive.prompt: Export my Donkey Cut project as a video file.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an export, reports progress, and returns a download link when it finishes.

negative.description: General knowledge with no video editing.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: A writing task with no project or footage.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
